theme: CS5-5 (= CS4-5) qualified pattern of another enum is E0405
text: CHECKER (checker.rs, all engines): a qualified pattern naming a variant of another known enum (D::Up, or a struct-form D::P { .. }) on a subject whose type is enum C is refused with E0405 ("this match is on C, but D::Up is a variant of D"), in match, if let and while let, and nested in Some/Ok/Err/tuple sub-patterns (NH-2 (a)). Such an arm could never match. New refusals of programs that run: dead arms of another enum's variant (v2q_noall, en), with or without a _ arm. An unknown variant keeps its E0001 alone; same-enum and non-enum subjects are unchanged. No interpreter or runtime change. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes and diagnostics as the base binary.
